task_contract.objective: Capture a reproducible RAG baseline and make requested versus effective embedding configuration truthful and fail-closed.
included: P0 regression tests for silent embedding degradation
requested and effective embedding profile contract
pipeline preflight and job creation guard when the requested provider is unavailable
task_contract.file_count_exception: Six files are required because the executor must consume the new effective profile; omitting it would cause canonical hash model metadata to instantiate a different embedder and break execution identity.
protected_state: shared Docker services and persistent volumes
task_contract.public_api_impact: Embedding profiles add requested and effective safe metadata while retaining flat effective fields for compatibility. Draft execution becomes fail-closed when a requested provider is unavailable.
task_contract.risk: high correctness risk, low data-mutation risk

acceptance.normal: An explicitly configured provider reports matching requested and effective provider/model metadata.
acceptance.degraded_local: An explicitly selected hash provider reports deterministic hash as both requested and effective without a semantic model label.
acceptance.blocked: An OpenAI-compatible request without credentials is persisted as unavailable, preflight is not ready, and no pipeline job is created.
acceptance.rollback: Revert only the six files listed in task_contract.allowed_paths; no active version or persistent data pointer changes are required.

covered_failures: real provider request silently downgraded to hash
unavailable provider did not block execution
configured provider did not expose requested and effective identity

failed_areas: skill Node and TypeScript execution environment
full_backend_regression.base_commit_comparison: The same 22 tests failed when rerun from the detached source commit; no RAG test failed.
